steps.message: Quick one-liner: bump the session timeout from 30 minutes to 8 hours in config.js. Just change the value, nothing fancy.

arguments.description: Show config and other timeout references

steps.message: The unit is minutes, so 8 hours = 480.

arguments.command: sed -i '' 's/SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 30,/SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 480,/' config.js && git diff && node server.js
arguments.description: Update timeout, show diff, run server

steps.message:
I changed `SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES` from `30` to `480` in `config.js`. The value is in minutes, so 480 is 8 hours. That's the only line I changed, and I haven't committed it.

I couldn't confirm it by starting the server. `node server.js` crashed because a `package.json` in a parent folder (`hyperpowers/evals/`) has `"type": "module"`, which makes Node reject `require` here. That's an existing setup problem and has nothing to do with this change.
